prompt: Print the sum of the squares of the integers 0 through 9.
title: Sum of squares

prompt: Start with the number 27. Repeatedly transform it: if it is even, halve it; if it is odd, triple it and add 1. Stop when it reaches 1. Print how many transformation steps were performed.
title: Hailstone steps

prompt: Print the greatest common divisor of 252 and 105.
title: Greatest common divisor

prompt: Print how many prime numbers are strictly less than 100.
title: Prime count

prompt: A sequence starts 1, 1, and each later term is the sum of the two terms before it. Print the 20th term.
title: Twentieth term

prompt: Print every perfect number greater than 0 and less than 1000 in increasing order, one per line. A number is perfect when it equals the sum of its positive divisors other than itself.
title: Perfect numbers

prompt: Build the list of the first 8 positive multiples of 3 in increasing order, then print the sum of its elements.
title: Multiples of three

prompt: A list contains 3, 8, -2, 12, 7. Print how many values are positive, then the largest value.
title: Positives and largest

prompt: A list contains 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 in that order. Print its elements in the opposite order, one per line.
title: Reverse order

prompt: A list contains 4, 1, 7, 3, 9, 2 in that order. Keep only the values greater than 3, print each kept value on its own line preserving their order, then print how many values were kept.
title: Filter and count

prompt: A list contains 5, 3, 8, 1, 9, 2. Print its elements in increasing order, one per line.
title: Sort ascending

prompt: The text is "stack". Print the text with its characters in the opposite order.
title: Reverse text

prompt: For each of the texts "level", "stereo", "rotor", in that order: print true if the text reads the same backward as forward, and false otherwise, one result per line.
title: Palindrome check

prompt: The text is "mississippi". Print how many times the character "s" occurs in it, then how many distinct characters it contains.
title: Character statistics

prompt: Parse the strings "12", "x", "30" as integers; print the sum of those that parse, then the count that failed.
title: Parse integers

prompt: Divide 100 by each of 5, 0, and 4 using whole-number division, in that order. For each division print the quotient on its own line, or the word undefined when the divisor is 0.
title: Safe division

prompt: A list contains 10, 20, 30 in that order. Look up the element at position 1, then the element at position 5, where positions count from 0. For each lookup print the element found, or -1 when the position is outside the list.
title: Bounded lookup

prompt: A sequence holds three shapes in order: a rectangle 3 by 4, a triangle with sides 3, 4, 5, and a rectangle 2 by 5. For each shape print its perimeter on its own line.
title: Shape perimeters

prompt: A rectangle has width 7 and height 4. Print its area, then its perimeter.
title: Rectangle measures

prompt: Three items are on record: pen with unit price 3 and quantity 4, pad with unit price 9 and quantity 2, and ink with unit price 5 and quantity 3. The cost of an item is its unit price times its quantity. Print the combined cost of all items, then the name of the item with the highest cost.
title: Inventory costs
